title: One dead, several injured after vehicle plows through crowd at Berlin Pride event
summary: Berlin police said they have identified a suspect who "is known to police" and has links to "Islamist circles."
contentText:
Germany's interior minister Alexander Dobrindt described the incident as a likely "Islamic terror attack", and named the suspect as Abdul Ballout, who was born in Germany and has Lebanese roots.

(Image credit: Andreas Rabenstein)
